_meta.description: Known mistakes/lessons for plugins. New entries only get added via ChangeGate's approve() (change_gate.py) -- never edited by hand as a shortcut around review.

patterns.whatToLookFor: Plugin scan reports vanilla Fallout 4 scripts such as workshopobjectscript as a "missing .pex" risk just because an object in the plugin uses them.
patterns.correction: Vanilla scripts (workshopobjectscript and the rest of the base game's scripts) already ship with Fallout 4, so a mod never needs to include their .pex files. Only warn about missing .pex for scripts that aren't part of the base game or DLC.

patterns.whatToLookFor: Copying records out of Fallout4.esm into a new non-localized plugin and keeping FULL/DESC/SHRT as-is. Fallout4.esm is localized, so those subrecords are 4-byte string-table IDs, not text; in a normal ESP they show as garbage names.
patterns.correction: When cloning a vanilla record into a non-localized plugin, replace FULL (and SHRT) with a null-terminated text string and drop or rewrite DESC. Clear the compressed record flag (0x40000) if you write the body uncompressed.

patterns.whatToLookFor: Needing a creature that stays rooted in place (plants, hazards) but copying a mobile vanilla creature NPC, so it walks or slides after the player.
patterns.correction: Set the SpeedMult actor value (AVIF 0x000002DA) to 0 in the NPC_ PRPS list. It keeps its turning, idle and attack animations but can't walk.
